summary: Phase-1 2.5D world port tested end-to-end (backend pytest 12/12 + Playwright desktop & mobile). Landing, register, login, guest, harbour walking (keys + tap), signpost prompts (+E), boat -> Travel Map, all 5 action-bar menus + More modal + logout, water mode (FIND SPOT -> FISH), cast/bite/TensionGame fight, catch card (Bowfin landed, gold 120->145, journal entry saved, no cheat_log flags, /fish/land 200 with no too-fast/too-slow), lost fight (slack toast -> idle), Back to Harbour, travel to Willow River (auto-switch to water mode, gold charged 150), multiplayer presence (API isolation by loc + UI __fx.others and here-count=2 with a 2nd user), pearls stripped from gear/bait, mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow. Found and FIXED 2 critical frontend bugs: (1) i18n never initialised so every t() string in all TFL pages rendered blank (Buy buttons, tab labels, column headers, panel titles); (2) 'Play now' guest button did nothing because reCAPTCHA was loaded with an undefined site key. One HIGH UX gap remains: no way to re-enter your current water from the harbour.

minor.issue: SIGNUPS_PER_IP_HOUR=3 is shared across everyone behind the preview ingress IP; tests hit 429 'Too many new accounts' quickly (cleared db.rate_events action=signup to continue). Expected prod behaviour, but note for testing.
Presence is an in-process dict (_pos) - will not be shared across multiple backend workers/replicas; fine for single worker.

ui_bugs.component: i18n (all TFL pages: Shop, Travel Map, Fishdex, Inventory, Profile...)
ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: initI18n() was never called, i18next.t() returned undefined so all tt() strings were empty (empty Buy buttons, unlabeled tabs, missing headers/titles). Added initI18n() call in src/index.js.

FIXED by testing agent: createGuest awaited recaptchaToken() with REACT_APP_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY undefined -> threw, no /api/auth/guest request was made. recaptchaToken now returns undefined when no site key (backend already skips check when RECAPTCHA_SECRET unset).

integration_issues.issue: After 'Back to Harbour' (or any page reload, which always starts in harbour mode), there is no UI path back into the water the user is currently assigned to: SAIL/boat opens Travel Map where the current water card only shows the text 'Fishing here' (no button), and travel only switches mode when user.water changes. Only workaround is URL /game/fish or travelling elsewhere and back.

issues: useScale clamps HUD scale to 0.55 -> player panel text, action-bar labels and walk hint render ~5-6px, essentially unreadable; consider a mobile-specific layout or min scale ~0.75
TFL page modals also rendered at 0.55 scale (Shop text very small)
Player nameplates overlap signpost labels (e.g. name covers 'Market' label at spawn)
Gear icons missing in Shop item column (known art gap) and broken image icon on 'Drop a crab cage' button in Travel Map Millbrook card
'416 species' feature vs Fishdex '413 discovered' total - inconsistent counts

action_items: Add a way to enter the current water from the harbour (e.g. 'Fish here'/'Go' button on the current water card in Travel Map, or make SAIL offer 'Return to <water>'); also consider persisting fx.mode across reloads
Improve mobile HUD readability (min scale or responsive layout)
Review the two fixes made by testing agent (src/index.js initI18n, tfl/lib/recaptcha.js no-key short-circuit)
Add TestAngler / TestAngler2 (Angler#2026) to /app/memory/test_credentials.md - currently missing from that file
critical_code_review_comments: World.js: page==='fish' and user.water effects call goTo() but omit it from deps; harmless now but fragile
Scene.js is 650 lines - near the 700-line split threshold
world_presence.py: no throttle on /world/pos and in-memory state; OK for phase 1
Headless browser ran at ~22fps and walking speed is dt-based so movement was slow in tests (not a bug)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass after 2 fixes; 1 integration gap)

context_for_next_testing_agent: window.__fx gives scene state; setting __fx.dest walks the angler but does not auto-open signposts (only clicking a signpost sets autoOpen) - use spot-prompt or E. When walking to the boat, wait until __fx.near==='boat' and __fx.dest is null (route passes Quest Board). Fight controller: hold Space when tension-needle style.left < zone center.
